current_execution_policy: These are the only proposed test purposes. No test may execute without real runtime call chain, selected Epic source line, and original genuine oracle.

reader_architecture.ue1: Independent complete CatalogUE1PackageReader.php parser, with UE1-specific native and tagged property readers; shares only bounded byte stream with UE2.
reader_architecture.ue2: Independent complete CatalogUE2PackageReader.php parser with game-specific snapshot policies; shares only bounded byte stream with UE1.
reader_architecture.ue5: UE5/UnrealPackageReader.php UnrealPackageReader5 plus separate Zen/IoStore reader and package store
reader_architecture.change_impact: Editing only one concrete engine parser affects its engine; shared CatalogLegacyBinaryStream, CatalogPackageTableReader interface, and common UEDB5 dependency/persistence services can affect more than one engine.
